data.completion_memo: Implemented a content-addressed local artifact store and disposable projection store. Artifact preparation hashes and durably promotes immutable objects before they are referenced; a durable SQLite token journal verifies hash/size and supports one-event finalization (or idempotent same-event retry), metadata is separate from paths, and range reads re-verify content. Projection rebuilds replace a timeline only from committed local ledger records in one SQLite transaction and are safely disposable. Tests cover prepare/finalize/read/token safety and rebuilding a timeline from committed history; cargo test -p aworkit-local-store passes.
data.description: Implement durable artifact prepare/reference/finalize semantics and replaceable query projections for Chat lists, timelines, evidence, search, and artifact joins. Projection rebuilds must consume canonical records, tolerate interruption, and never become evidence or history authority.
data.title: M02.3 — Implement artifact storage and disposable query projections
